title: Scenario template
description:
docs/data_model.md section 3.1, ADR-022. A manufactured negotiation to run, as JSON. Every file in `scenarios/` validates against this in CI.

The file holds both mandates, so a scenario file is **private experimental input** as a whole: `GET /v1/scenarios` lists only the public fields and `GET /v1/scenarios/{id}` requires the observer reveal header. Nothing here describes a real asset, a real counterparty or a real price.

`confirmation_threshold` is deliberately absent. It is a property of the chain a run executes on — 1 locally, 2 on Sepolia (ADR/Q14) — not of the economics being tested, and a scenario that carried one would silently change the meaning of a run moved between profiles.

Feasibility is also absent, and no field implies it. Whether the two mandates overlap is computed by the evaluator alone and is never exposed on a setup route (docs/api_contract.md section 2.1).

scenario_id.description: Stable identifier, upserted on startup. Changing it creates a second scenario rather than editing the first, which is what keeps earlier runs' provenance readable.

publicConfig.description: Everything both agents may see. These values reach the observation; the party templates do not, except each party's own.

base_amount_minor.description: The fixed quantity of mASSET. Fixed quantity is what makes this a price-only negotiation (ADR-001).

offer_lifetime_s.description: Upper bound on an offer's life; the signer caps it at session expiry (docs/protocol.md section 6).

first_proposer.description: Buyer only in v0.1. The contract enforces it, so any other value would be refused on-chain rather than producing a different negotiation.

initial_balances.description: Standardised across scenarios and deliberately not equal to the reservation price. A public balance still reveals financial capacity, as it would on any public ledger, but it must not reveal the private bound (system spec section 2.3).

allowance_minor.description: Allowance granted to the exchange during setup. The exchange can move no more than this, whatever is signed.
